chronology.allowed_wording: The MOT20 population and split rule were pre-specified before MOT17 execution; evaluator-native MOT20 GT semantics were completed afterward from the already-pinned TrackEval implementation, before any MOT20 execution.
chronology.forbidden_claim: the complete MOT20 estimand was fully specified before all MOT17 results

crowd_ignore_semantics.post_preprocessing: non-pedestrian GT is not part of the evaluated pedestrian GT set

distractor_preprocessing.explicit_difference: MOT20 ADDS non_mot_vehicle (class 6) to the distractor set; MOT17 does not. The MOT17 distractor list must not be transferred to MOT20.
distractor_preprocessing.mechanism: TrackEval matches tracker predictions against GT with its frozen Hungarian/IoU preprocessing and removes tracker detections matched to these distractor classes.

evaluator_naming.disclaimer: 'val' is a STUDY-SIDE split identifier only. It does NOT imply that MOTChallenge publishes an official MOT20-val split; the population is constructed from MOT20 train.
evaluator_naming.rationale: BENCHMARK must remain MOT20 so the frozen evaluator activates MOT20 native preprocessing, including non_mot_vehicle

scoreable_gt_predicate.additional_filters: NONE. No visibility, crowd-density, box-size or occlusion filter is applied, because the frozen evaluator requires none for this target predicate.
scoreable_gt_predicate.used_for: the V9 STV reference population on MOT20

source_of_semantics.derivation: mechanical; verified against the pinned source, 10/10 checks PASS
source_of_semantics.principle: MOT20 evaluation and GT semantics are defined by the NATIVE MOT20 branch of the already-frozen evaluator. They are NOT copied from MOT17.

stv_vs_trackeval.anchors_may_not_match: distractor, crowd or non-pedestrian objects as scoreable STV references
stv_vs_trackeval.conflation: FORBIDDEN; these are two distinct operations
stv_vs_trackeval.trackeval_preprocessing: native MOT20 preprocessing from the pinned evaluator, including distractor handling before final pedestrian-only GT retention
